source_label: The three official team-stat pages re-read on 2026-11-16 and re-cut into one row per team: traditional, opponent and advanced. The NBA prints no source URL inside the table, so each block names the page URL it came from.

notes.note: mode for traditional and opponent, totals mode for advanced (MIN is season minutes
notes.check: overtime; the refresh script reports the implied OT count per team.

W_plus_L_equals_GP.rule: W + L == GP on all three pages

points_identity.rule: |PTS - (2*FGM + 3PM + FTM)| <= 0.25 (per-game rounding bound for a 4-term identity)

minutes_imply_overtime.rule: MIN - 48*GP is a non-negative multiple of 5 on the advanced page
